title: Record cost and inference events for every harness run
narrative: Finance asks Nubble whether a harness run actually burned billable units. He runs a short one-shot job and checks the event log. He needs both an inference event and a cost event with non-zero units — the same signals he would forward to billing or a Grafana panel.
implementation:
Harness runs emit structured `EventLog` records for inference and cost (`CostAccountant` / `core:cost`, `core:inference`). This is the baseline observability stream for every run — decisions, routing, and tools extend the same log rather than a separate ledger.

Covers: OBS-01.
validation: Kind `pass_through` → `_run_pass_through`. Soft expects: inference and cost events with non-zero units. Related: `tests/test_events.py`, `tests/test_pass_through.py`.
